about: Proportional spacing for the menu font. gap: pixels between letters. space: a space's width. maxKern: how far automatic kerning may pull a pair together (0 turns it off). advance / left / kern: per-letter and per-pair overrides, for example "advance": { "i": 3 }, "kern": { "Te": -1 }. clear: the fewest pixels kept clear between a letter and the letters either side, never kerned closer, for example "clear": { "'": 1, ".": 1 }.
